name: Piyush Bhagat
player_statement:
A complete player, Piyush Bhagat has made a big mark in cricket. With 118 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 70, with an average of 20.99 and a quick strike rate of 113.15. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 85 sixes and 187 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 139.2 overs, taking 52 wickets at an economy rate of 7.84. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
